metadata.title: Minimal translation hypersurfaces in hyperbolic space
metadata.abstract: In the upper half-space model of the hyperbolic space $\mathbb{H}^{n+1}$, a translation hypersurface of type I is a graph $x_{n+1}=f_1(x_1)+\cdots+f_n(x_n)$ and a translation hypersurface of type II is a graph $x_n=f_1(x_1)+\cdots+f_{n-1}(x_{n-1})+g(x_{n+1})$. We classify the minimal translation hypersurfaces of both types for every $n\geq 2$. We obtain these results as particular cases of a classification of the singular minimal translation hypersurfaces of $\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$ for an arbitrary exponent $\alpha\neq 0$, with respect to a direction orthogonal (type I) or parallel (type II) to the hyperplane over which the hypersurface is a graph. The minimal translation hypersurfaces of type I are exactly the parabolic cylinders over a one-parameter family of arches, which contradicts a nonexistence theorem in the literature. The minimal translation hypersurfaces of type II are the parabolic cylinders, the vertical totally geodesic hyperplanes and, when $n\geq 3$, the vertical cylinders over the Scherk surface.

analysis.progressType: 双曲空间 minimal translation hypersurface 分类
analysis.workSummary: 对两类可加分离的 translation graph，经 Euclidean singular minimal equation 分类，给 parabolic cylinder、vertical totally geodesic 及高维 Scherk cylinder 分支。
analysis.breakthrough: 纠正文献中的部分不存在结论并给完整所述类别。
analysis.limitations: 分类针对 type I/II 分离形式，不能等同全部双曲极小超曲面分类。
analysis.priorityReason: 纠正文献中的部分不存在结论并给完整所述类别。
